messages:
maya: Quick sync — launch week plan for the webinar + post series. Need a tiny SEO tasking list: keywords, minimal schema, internal linking priority, and redirect fallbacks. Goal: landing + 3 launch posts + webinar signups funnel.
alex: Sounds good. do we have a finalized keyword list or should the comms team + SEO pick top 5 per asset?
maya: I have a draft KW list — will paste below. prefer top 3 primary + 2 supporting per page. can someone QA relevance/intent?
jamie: I can take the landing + webinar page. will check search intent (informational vs transactional).
ben: I’ll own the 3 launch posts and the canonical mapping. will add internal link anchor plan.
lara: I’ll do redirects and microcopy for CTAs. want the canonical redirect fallback if we change slug mid-launch.
seo-bot: Reminder: measure CTR uplift in the benchmark narrative. Track baseline sessions 7 days before launch. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maya: Draft keywords (primary | supporting):
- landing: "redwood inference" | "low-latency LLM inference", "inference platform"
- webinar: "llm inference best practices" | "inference cost optimization", "runtime batching"
- post A (benchmarks): "inference latency benchmark" | "throughput per GPU", "serverless vs dedicated inference"
- post B (case study): "inference cost savings" | "quantization savings", "kv cache caching"
- post C (how-to): "model rollout strategies" | "canary model deploy", "fallback routing"
jamie: Nice. For landing we should target branded KW + a high-intent phrase. I’ll surface meta description variants.
ben: Internal linking plan (high-level):
- Landing -> Webinar (hero CTA)
- Landing -> Post A (benchmark highlights snippet)
- Each Post -> Landing (CTA: try demo) + Cross-link to other posts in the series
- Webinar page -> Resources section with direct anchors to slides + benchmark post
lara: Redirect plan: if we change slugs during last-minute edits, canonical should point to /launch/redwood-inference and we add 301s for old slugs. Example rules (Nginx):
```
rewrite ^/old-launch-slug/?$ /launch/redwood-inference permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar-registration-old/?$ /events/redwood-inference-webinar permanent;
```
alex: Nice, keep the live redirect map in the docs site (we’ll link from the PR). Also add temporary 302 for A/B test variants.
maya: Schema: minimal JSON-LD for webinar and landing. Jamie can tweak. Example snippet:```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar","startDate":"2025-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/redwood-inference-webinar","description":"Live demo and benchmarks of low-latency LLM inference."}
```
jamie: For blogposts we’ll add Article schema with author and mainEntityOfPage. Also add breadcrumb schema for the series.
ben: Microcopy: CTA variants — "See live benchmarks" / "Register for launch demo" / "Get startup credits". Use UTM template: ?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch2025&utm_content={cta}
lara: Ops note: deploy redirect rules in staging first, smoke test 301s with curl and check canonical header. e.g. `curl -I https://redwood.inference/old-launch-slug`
seo-bot: Add a test to the benchmark narrative: capture median p95 latency and token cost per 1k tokens, compare vs baseline model. Tag with experiment id.
maya: Action items:
- jamie: finalize meta + Article schema by EOD Tue
- ben: internal links & canonical map + post drafts by Thu
- lara: redirect rules + microcopy variants + staging rollout Wed
- alex: add redirect map to PR and set 302 for test slugs
- maya: update keyword file and push final to /docs/seo/launch-kw.csv
Will follow up in product-ops tomorrow. Thanks all. :rocket:
